newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech MiG crashes, pilot severely injured.
newsitem.headline: Czech MiG crashes, pilot severely injured.

text.p: A Czech MiG-21 jet fighter crashed in eastern Bohemia on Monday night with its pilot receiving severe injuries, the Czech news agency CTK reported.
The Soviet-designed jet crashed into a field and the cause was being investigated, CTK quoted police as saying.
The Czech Republic, which is a front runner for early membership of the NATO defence alliance, wants to modernise its air force, which is part of the army.
It has considered upgrading its old Warsaw Pact-era MiG-21s or buying U.S.-made jets.
